note: Careless loiter (brief 031), the twin of route-b, recomposed on engine 0.43.0 (Keel for Waymark, brief 096: it lost to the lookout since 0.41.0, which is not what it tests): route-b as today (the lend, the lookout misled), but once the Listen is over the Scout walks back to stand by the driver in the pickup camera's view and waits there before his walk to the lookout. Standing there is the carelessness: the camera notices him and reports him; the route still wins, at a higher Alert than its twin.
